source_entity: SS7 - New settlement at Dunsfold Aerodrome
evidence_slice: Waverley Borough Council identifies Dunsfold Aerodrome as a strategic site allocation in Local Plan Part 1. Policies SS7 and SS7a apply; Policy SS7 allocates Dunsfold Aerodrome for around 2,600 homes plus other uses, and the Council states that hybrid outline planning permission for 1,800 homes was granted in March 2018.
